name: 23189-varoutput-30ba3b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, bf16, unquantized. Not the FP8 sibling: moe_intermediate_size 768 is 96 per rank at TP8, and a block-FP8 checkpoint with block_n 128 will not launch on a width that 128 does not divide.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8, EP off, PP=1, DP=1, no DP attention. Overlap scheduling is left at its default, which is on.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30B total / ~3B active. 48 layers, GQA 32 query / 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 routed experts at top-8, context 262144. ~60 GB of bf16 weights, ~7.5 GB per rank at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text over HTTP, single turn, no prefix. 256 prompt tokens in, fixed at exactly that; out 900 tokens with stdev 58, floored at 800 and capped at 1000.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 900-token answers from short prompts for 256 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server args for this item. Flat `key: value` only.
#
# chunked-prefill-size and mem-fraction-static are COUPLED: the engine sizes its activation
# reserve at ~1.5 MB per prefill token, so 16384 already costs ~27 GB of an 80 GB card. Raising
# the chunk size without lowering the static fraction will not start.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 8
max-running-requests: 2048
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
max-prefill-tokens: 16384
mem-fraction-static: 0.66
